Title: Junkrat Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue preventing Boosters from receiving the Rush-down Talent's cooldown reduction bonus if D.Va was attacking an enemy shortly before activating Boosters.

=== Heroes: Junkrat ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Using Concussion Mine to destroy D.Va's Mech and knock her into the terrain will no longer remove her from the Battleground until she respawns.
